text: `doc/man_docs.go` generates man pages. `GenMan` initializes a nil header, fills its defaults, renders the command through `md2man`, and writes it (`doc/man_docs.go:103-116`). `fillHeader` defaults the title, section, date—honoring `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`—and autogenerated source text (`doc/man_docs.go:118-141`); tree generation is configured through `GenManTreeOptions` (`doc/man_docs.go:82-88`).
